trial.detail: This triage is checked against your own testing. Nothing on your list has been removed: run your own steps and the checks under "Already proven", and say whether each proof held.
trial.feedback: For each Testing item you tick off, write one line, repo#number: label right; steps complete; proven held; groups ok; someone_else none; bug none (or wrong, missing <what>, failed <which>, <n> should <group>, the check numbers, or the bug in one line; proven none when nothing is under Already proven), or use the pr-triage-feedback/1 JSON block posted on issue #5. Anything else is treated as a possible failure and followed up by hand, so if unsure, write it out plainly.

group_notes.matter: The main change and anything high risk. Test these.
group_notes.proven: Optional. CI or a check on the deployed site already proves these, and a reviewer agreed. Open one to run it anyway.
group_notes.someone_else: You can't check these yourself. Pass them on if they matter today.
group_notes.deeper: More checks we found, listed here so nothing is hidden. Etienne's tool keeps their steps; not needed for the trial.
